# Planning governance index

| Concern | Authority |
| --- | --- |
| Vision and direction | `VISION.md` |
| Strategy choices and exclusions | `docs/dev/planning/strategy.md` |
| Current product outcome and workspace milestone | `docs/dev/planning/product.md` |
| Long-term direction | `docs/dev/planning/roadmap.md` |
| Semantic core boundary and rationale | `docs/adr/ADR-001-semantic-core.md` |
| Process/physical model constraint | `docs/contracts/process-physical-model.md` |
| Historical gate decisions | `docs/dev/planning/gates/` |
| Bounded Issue scope | `issues/` (mutable; export and hash for review) |

A directional capability is not authorization. Current product outcome outranks
an attractive future capability when they conflict.
